<!-- Generated by scripts/data/fetch-charters.js, then transcribed by hand from the
     page images, as the header instructed. The page bodies are rasterized, so
     pdftotext recovers nothing; the JPEGs were pulled straight out of the PDF's
     DCTDecode streams and read page by page. Field labels and section headings are
     the charter's own. Re-running the fetch script will NOT regenerate this text -
     it will report drift by sha256 only.
 -->

Like BPLO's, this charter is a set of infographics rather than the ARTA table the
seven text-extractable offices use. Each page carries CLASSIFICATION, TYPE OF
TRANSACTION and WHO MAY AVAIL across the top, then three columns headed STEPS,
CLIENT and AGENCY ACTION, with RESPONSIBLE PERSON inside the agency column and a
single PROCESSING TIME for the whole service at the foot.

The office is organised into divisions and every page is badged with the one that
owns the service: CPDO-ADMIN, CPDO Zoning Division, CPDO-HHRD (Housing and Homesite
Regulation Division), CPDO-PPD (Plans and Programs Division), CPDO-SPD (Special
Projects Division) and CPDO-RESD (Research and Statistics Division).

Most pages close with:

> Amount of fees and taxes to be paid in the Tax Order of Payment issued by the CTO
> with reference to the City Ordinance No. 13-2007, and City Zoning Ordinance No.
> 14-0011-2019

The HHRD, PPD, SPD and RESD pages cite City Ordinance No. 13-2007 only. Unlike
BPLO, four services do publish amounts; those are transcribed in full below.

Of the PDF's 23 pages, 18 carry a rasterized body and are transcribed here. The
remaining five yielded no image and appear to be covers or dividers.

## Page 1. Incoming Communications | CPDO-ADMIN

CLASSIFICATION: SIMPLE TRANSACTION
TYPE OF TRANSACTION: BACKLINE SERVICE
WHO MAY AVAIL: Clients, Other Offices / Agencies

**1 SUBMIT.** Client, 1.0 REQUIRED DOCUMENTS ARE LISTED BELOW: Letters,
Transmittals, Memos, etc. Documents, attachments, etc.

Agency action: 1. The Client submits Communication (physically or electronically)
to CPDO-Administrative Section or CPDO email address or Facebook Page. 2. RESD
Staff acknowledges receipt and records Communication in Logbook, then forwards to
the Office Head/Assistant/Officer-in-Charge for appropriate action. 3. Office
Head/Assistant/Officer-in-Charge acts on the Communication or refers to Concerned
Personnel. 4. Concerned Personnel acts upon the Communication.

RESPONSIBLE PERSON: Marivi I. Doroliat - Administrative Assistant I. Ma. Edna A.
Acerado - Administrative Aide IV. Marian Kate B. Ang - Administrative Aide I.

**2 PAY.** 2.0 PAYMENT. Note: Payment for this particular service is not
applicable. Agency action: 2.0 Not Applicable.

**3 CLAIM.** 3.0 Not applicable. Agency action: 3.0 Not Applicable.

PROCESSING TIME: 3 DAYS (MAXIMUM)

## Page 3. Online/Face to Face Application for Locational Clearance for New Business Permit Application | CPDO Zoning Division

CLASSIFICATION: SIMPLE
TYPE OF TRANSACTION: GOVERNMENT TO CLIENT
WHO MAY AVAIL: THOSE APPLYING FOR A LOCATIONAL CLEARANCE FOR NEW BUSINESS PERMIT

**1 SUBMIT.** 1.0 Applicant submits/sends an e-file copy of the following
documentary requirements at legazpicpdo@gmail.com/CPDO:

- Properly filled-out Application Form for Business/Mayor's Permit in Jpeg format
  for online application
- 1 page Sketch/drawing of proposed business location in Jpeg format for online
  application
- 1 copy of Barangay Business Clearance (where business is located) in Jpeg format
  for online application
- If the property is not owned: 1 copy of Contract of Lease or Letter of
  Authorization/Consent from the owner/s/ Affidavit of Undertaking (Lot Ownership)/
  Award Notice in Jpeg format for online application
- 1 Copy of Occupancy Permit or Certification (for the building where business is
  located) in Jpeg format for online application
- 1 Original copy of the previous Locational Clearance, for existing businesses
  with changes in Jpeg format for online application
- 1 Copy of DTI/SEC Certificate/CDA Registration in Jpeg format

Agency action: 1.1 ZD Staff acknowledges receipt of submitted application forwarded
by the Business Center (BPLO). 1.2 If submitted application is INCOMPLETE, or with
DEFICIENCIES to be complied, ZD Staff issues Notice of Deficiency to Applicant's
email address. Applicant complies with documentary requirements then, re-submits for
re-evaluation to ZD's email address. If submitted application is COMPLETE, ZD Staff
issues Zoning Fee/Order of Payment for BPLO reference then, prepares/processes
application for review and approval/signature of Zoning Officer and Zoning
Administrator/CPDC. If submitted application is non-conforming with the City Zoning
Ordinance, ZD Staff prepares a notice of denial, for signature of the Zoning
Administrator/CPDC.

RESPONSIBLE PERSONS: Mr. Francisco (Frankie) Salvador R. Palacio, Zoning Inspector
I. Ar. Marion Dale B. Maravilla, Zoning Officer I. Ar. Jessica O. Rañeses, Zoning
Officer II. Ar. Ma. Joy Antonette A. Balde, Zoning Officer III. Enp. Jocelyn M.
Codorniz, Zoning Administrator/ CPDC.

**2 PAY.** 2.0 Applicant pays Zoning Fee, which is included in the ONE-TIME
ASSESSMENT OF FEES to be issued by BPLO, at the City Treasurer's Office or through
Legazpi City's Online Services. Agency action: 2.1 ZD Staff prepares transmittal
then, transmits approved locational clearances to the Business Center (BPLO).
Responsible Person: Revenue Collection Officer, City Treasurer's Office.

**3 CLAIM.** 3.0 Applicant receives the Locational Clearance upon release of the
Mayor's/Business Permit at the Business Center (BPLO). Agency action: 3.1 Releasing
of Documents. Responsible Person: Releasing Officer, City Business Permits and
Licensing Office.

PROCESSING TIME: One (1) day max.

CLASSIFICATION: SIMPLE
TYPE OF TRANSACTION: GOVERNMENT TO CLIENT

## Page 10. Face-to-Face Application for Preliminary Application for Locational Clearance (PALC) | CPDO-HHRD

CLASSIFICATION: HIGHLY TECHNICAL TRANSACTION
TYPE OF TRANSACTION: GOVERNMENT TO CLIENT FRONTLINE SERVICE
WHO MAY AVAIL: Any Lot owner within the City of Legazpi with the intention to
DEVELOP subject lot/land.

**1 SUBMIT.** 1.0 SUBMIT THE FOLLOWING REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:

- 6 sets of Subdivision Scheme/Plan showing the proposed layout, Vicinity Map and
  Survey Plans of the Lot as described in the TCT, and is duly signed and sealed by a
  licensed Geodetic Engineer.
- 1 copy of Certified true copies of Title/s (TCT) and 5 xerox copies of the same
  document
- 1 original copy of Certified true copy of Tax Declaration and 5 xerox copies of the
  same document
- 1 original copy of Tax Clearance and 5 xerox copies of the same document
- 1 original copy of Certification of non-tenancy or an affidavit of waiver of tenant
  if the land is agricultural/pasture land planted to rice and corn and 5 xerox
  copies of the same document
- 1 original copy of Sangunian Panlungsod (Legazpi) Resolution on re-classification,
  if existing land use classification is agricultural and 5 xerox copies of the same
  document
- 1 original copy of Deed of Sale, Deed of Donation, Deed of Extrajudicial
  Settlement, Deed of Self-adjudication, Memorandum of Agreement, Subdivision
  Agreement (Any of the documents stated that would establish ownership of the lot.)
  and 5 xerox copies of the same document
- 1 original copy of Right to use of RROW Agreement or right to use RROW, when
  applicable and 5 xerox copies of the same document
- 1 original copy of Special Power of Attorney or Corporate Secretary Certificate and
  5 xerox copies of the same document
- 1 original copy of Site Zoning/Land Use Classification Certification and 5 xerox
  copies of the same document

Agency action: 1.1 The Applicant submits Application for PALC to CPDO-HHRD. If the
application is satisfactory complied with ALL the requirements, proceed to STEP 4.
1.2 If it is found INCOMPLETE, or with DEFICIENCIES, the HHRD Staff issues Notice of
Deficiency to the Applicant for its immediate compliance. Then, the applicant must
re-submit the document/s to the HHRD for its re-evaluation. 1.3 The HHRD staff will
re-evaluate the re-submitted documents. 1.4 If the submitted application is
COMPLETE, HHRD Staff officially receives the application. 1.5 HHRD staff prepares
and forwards endorsement/transmittal letter of the application to City Legal Office
(CLO) and City Engineering Office (CEO) for comments/recommendations. 1.6 City Legal
Office and City Engineering Office will forward to HHRD their comments and
recommendations. If the application is recommended for approval, proceed to STEP 8.
1.7 If the application is WITH FINDINGS, HHRD staff prepares
endorsement/transmittal letter of the deficiencies back to the applicant, for
compliance. Then, the applicant must submit the requested/rectified document/s. 1.8
HHRD Staff conducts ocular inspection/on-site investigation. 1.9 HHRD prepares an
Inspection Report and endorses findings/recommendations to Applicant if there are
issues to be clarified. 1.10 HHRD prepares an endorsement letter, and forwards to
the City Mayor's Office (CMO) for its endorsement to the Sangguniang Panlungsod
(SP). 1.11 HHRD Staff attend the scheduled SP Committee Hearing and present the
technicality of the PALC application and recommend approval of application. 1.12 The
HHRD receives the SP Resolution Approving the PALC Application, the HHRD Staff
issues Order of Payment and prepares the marking of the plan for the signature of
CPDC & the City Mayor. 1.13 The CMO endorses the Approved PALC to the CPDO and the
HHRD notify the applicant that the application is ready to be claimed.

RESPONSIBLE PERSON: Hon. Hisham B. Ismail, City Mayor. Enp. Jocelyn M. Codorniz,
CGDH-I/CPDC. Ar. Maridel L. Baldano-Nierva, HHRO V. Ar. Camelle D. Celeste-Abion,
HHRO II. Ar. Diana Rose B. Ruivivar, Draftswoman I.

**2 PAY.** 2.0 PAYMENT. 2.1 Proceed to the City Treasurer's Office to pay the
Processing Fee.

- Processing Fee - Php 360.00/Has. (PD957)
- Php 90.00/Has. (BP220-Socialized)
- Php 216.00/Has. (BP220-Economic)

## Page 18. Feedback and Complaints Mechanism

HOW TO SEND FEEDBACK: Call at PLDT 742-0821. Email at legazpicpdo@gmail.com.
Accomplish the Feedback Form.

HOW FEEDBACKS ARE PROCESSED? 1. Clients are given the Feedback Form based on the
number of services they availed. 2. The assigned Officer colicet these forms at the
end of transaction day and submit to the Administrative Officer for recording. 3.
These are then collated per quarter and averaged as to the rating each client gave
per services availed. 4. The collated rating per quarter are then presented under
the Client Satisfaction Measurement (CSM) Report to get the Office rating. 5. The
report is then submitted to the City Human Resource Management Office (CHRMO) for
the collation of the Agencies Rating to be presented under the Harmonized CSM Report
which will be submitted to the Anti-Red Tape Authority.

HOW TO FILE A COMPLAINT: Complaints may be filed in writing or in person. You may
send a letter of complaint addressed to EnP Jocelyn M. Codorniz - City Planning &
Development Coordinator or email it at jocelyncodorniz29@gmail.com. You may call or
Text your complaint at 0919-841-3056.

HOW COMPLAINTS ARE PROCESSED? 1. In the Client Satisfaction Measurement (CSM) Survey
Form, the client (online or walk-in) can air their complaints/suggestions through
online or face to face. These complaint/s are assessed as to what action/s shall be
taken. 2. The Head of Office calls the attention of the concerned Officer to verify
the veracity of the complaint. 3. When the complaint is checked as to its veracity,
the Head of Office will then act on the complaint. This can fall under the light
offense or grave offense depending on the commission of the act. The City Human
Resource Management Office is called to assist, can apply their corresponding
sanction/s. 4. If the client ask for an appropriate action in the form of a letter,
he/she shall be given appropriate feedback as to the action/s applied to rectify the
act which need to be addressed.

CONTACT INFORMATION OF CONTACT CENTER NG BAYAN, PCC, ARTA. Contact Center ng Bayasn
(CCB): contactcentemgbayan.gov.ph. Presidential Complaint Center (PCB):
pcc@malacanang.gov.ph. Anti-Red Tape Authority (ARTA): For concems or complaints
call at 1-ARTA (1-complaints2782) or Text at 0969-257-7242/0928-690-4080 or you may
send your complaints to complaints@arta.gov.ph.
